content:
Are you just looking for guidance on where the send button is located? It's the triagular icon ▷ on the top toolbar of the compose/reply screen.

If send or other buttons are missing from the toolbar, an issue report is open for this on github. Bug Report: https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-android/issues/10988

Please add your feedback to this ticket.

You can also find the topic discussed on the K9 forum. https://forum.k9mail.app/t/no-send-button-in-k-9-mail-18-0/14346

  • Have you tried changing theme color to see if it returns?
  • What version of Android OS and Thunderbird are you using on your mobile/tablet?

If your issue is something different, please elaborate with more details!
